claims: C1 by default the assistant should avoid quantifying its uncertainty
C2 the avoidance applies unless the user or developer has explicitly requested quantification
C3 an explicit request from the user or developer permits quantifying uncertainty

concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not state the authority level

concepts.name: uncertainty_expression
concepts.gloss: U is an expression of uncertainty that quantifies it, such as a percentage or confidence interval

concepts.name: explicit_user_or_developer_request
concepts.gloss: U is an uncertainty expression that the user or developer has explicitly requested
